deck_context.source_summary: Week 12 integrates familiar computational methods. Students start with the output sought, identify the matching learned method and limitation, audit supplied or AI-assisted code, trace one algorithmic step, choose a validation check, and assemble a bounded capstone evidence packet for Week 13.
deck_context.locked_model: Newton cooling: dT/dt=-(T-Tenv)/tau, Tenv=20 deg C, T0=80 deg C, tau=100 s, 0<=t<=200 s. Euler dt=20 s endpoint 26.4425 deg C; Euler dt=10 s endpoint 27.2946 deg C; exact endpoint 28.1201 deg C. Defective plus-sign first update gives 92 deg C. tau=150 s is a controlled physical modification that predicts slower cooling.
deck_context.assessment_boundary: Week 12 studio is formative. It does not add a graded portfolio packet or new defence entry. Week 13 retains the final bounded investigation, individual defence and handoff.
deck_context.universal_constraints: All equations, signs, code identifiers, units, values and graph relationships are strict source facts. Use supplied evidence; do not introduce a new required method or confidential assessment content.
